CustomField.description: Hide delete button for specifed users based on the fromula condition
CustomField.formula: OR($Profile.Name = "System Administrator", AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(NSP_Type__c, "Common Ownership"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Type__c, "Influencer"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Type__c, "Private Equity"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Type__c, "Venture Capital"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Type__c, "Foreign Ownership"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Type__c, "Common Ownership"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Type__c, "ITA Support Group"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Type__c, "PSPM Support Group"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Type__c, "OrgPlus Support Group") ), OR( $Profile.Name = "BPS Service",$Profile.Name = "PEO Service",$Profile.Name = "Retirement Services" ) ) )
